name: Cardinal Hills
title: Cardinal Hills Window Cleaning, Pure Water Glass | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning in Cardinal Hills near Hudson Bend and Lake Travis. Gentle on older frames, no soap film, outside windows $10 each. Text for a quote.
intro: Cardinal Hills is an established neighborhood off RM 620 with big trees and homes from the 1970s through the 2000s. CleanzATX is based just up the road in Lakeway and cleans here often.

sections.h2: What Cardinal Hills homes are like
paragraphs: This subdivision sits off RM 620, close to Hudson Bend and the shore of Lake Travis, with a Lakeway extraterritorial jurisdiction address and Austin mail. Homes range from small 1,000 square foot houses up to 4,600 square foot custom builds. Prices start around the mid $400Ks and reach $1.3M. Because it was built over three decades, one street can include a 1970s ranch, a 1990s two story and a new rebuild. A voluntary neighborhood association exists, and there is no gate.

The neighborhood has a settled feel. Trees have had time to grow, yards are established and many owners have lived here for a long time. People tend to care about upkeep, and clean glass is the easiest improvement to see from the curb.

sections.h2: What Cardinal Hills windows deal with
paragraphs: Big trees are the main factor. Oaks and cedar shade the glass and drop leaves and seeds into screens and tracks. Spiders favor shady frames, so webs return fast. Pollen is heavy in season: cedar from December to February, live oak in March and April.

Older windows often have wood or aluminum frames and tracks with years of grime built up. Newer vinyl replacements are easier but still collect pollen film. If you live closer to the water, spray and sprinkler water leave white spots that we treat at $10 per pane. Pure water then dries the glass clean and leaves no soap film behind.

There is no gate to plan around. We park at the curb or in the driveway and use poles to reach upper glass from the ground, so ladders stay off older siding and trim. Screens come off, get brushed and go back, and tracks get cleaned by hand at $5 each. Houses on bigger lots often want the roof soft washed or the driveway cleaned, so we price those as one visit. Because Cardinal Hills is close to Lakeway, scheduling usually fits into a normal two week window.

A 2,500 square foot home is about $250 for exterior windows at $10 per window. Plan on about two to two and a half hours outside, and about 75 minutes more for the inside. Smaller homes still meet the $200 minimum.

why: Mature tree shade means webs and leaf litter, handled with screen and track care.
Older frames cleaned gently with pure water and soft tools.
Close to our Lakeway base, so scheduling stays flexible.
Prices fit a wide mix of home sizes from small to large.

faq.q: Do you clean homes near Hudson Bend?
faq.a: Yes. This area is close to our Lakeway base. Send your street and we confirm a time, usually within about two weeks.

faq.q: Is the Cardinal Hills price the same as Lakeway?
faq.a: Yes. For the outside, the rate is $10 a window, which works out to about $0.10 per square foot. Our minimum job is $200, and typical homes run about $350.

faq.q: My windows have old wood frames. Can you clean them?
faq.a: Yes. Pure water avoids harsh soap that can dull or stain old wood. We use soft brushes on frames and tell you if we see rot or damage.

faq.q: Can you clean the screens as well?
faq.a: Screens are $5 each, $10 for full screens and $15 for solar. We take them off, brush them and put them back. Triannual, Quarterly and Every 2 Months plans include one free screen cleaning a year.

faq.q: What if spots return after a few days?
faq.a: Send us a photo. Every job has a 7 day touch up, and when we are in the area we come back free. Plans such as Triannual add a 7 day rain guarantee.
